title: Psychiatric patient picking up radio signals through a filling
summary: Diane Powell tells of Psychiatric patient picking up radio signals through a filling, about c. 1995-2000 at Diane Powell's psychiatric practice, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: almost 30 years ago who had you know a filling and she was you know getting you know radio signals off of it

plain: A psychiatrist named Diane Powell tells podcast host Jesse Michels about a patient she saw almost 30 years ago, in the late 1990s. She says the woman had a dental filling and was picking up radio signals through it. She raises it while discussing claims that some people can receive information in unusual ways, such as telepathy.
